## Payment

A settlement fact: amount (base `AmountWithCurrency`), method enum (card / bank transfer / cash / other), paid-at timestamp, external reference, linked Invoice.

```ts
import { Payment } from '../payment';
```

**Non-goals:** payment processing/gateway integration, refunds as negative payments, allocation across multiple invoices.

A payment may be partial: `../Payment/pay-inv-2026-052-1` covers roughly half of INV-2026-052, which stays status `partial` with the balance derived on the invoice.
